hook.en: Firm, small rubbing strokes across the fibres of a tendon or ligament, applied exactly on the sore spot.
hook.ur: Cyriax Deep Transverse Friction mein symptomatic tendon, ligament ya muscle ke tissue par us ke fibres ki direction ke aar-paar localized pressure aur movement di jati hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll know what Cyriax Deep Transverse Friction is, when it's safe and useful, how to apply it step by step — and how to prove it worked. (3 checks along the way.)
goal.ur: End tak aap jaan jayenge ke Cyriax Deep Transverse Friction kya hai, kab safe aur faida-mand hai, qadam ba qadam kaise apply hoti hai — aur kaise prove karein ke kaam kiya. (Raste mein 3 checks.)

text.en: Deep Transverse Friction (DTF) is a technique where you press into a tendon or ligament and rub back and forth across the direction of its fibres, right over the tender area. It is used for tendon and ligament problems after the exact location has been found by examination.
text.ur: Yeh technique historically kisi symptomatic tendon, ligament ya muscle lesion par fibres ke transverse direction mein localized soft-tissue loading ke liye istemal hoti rahi hai.

simpler.en: Firm, small rubbing strokes across the fibres of a tendon or ligament, applied exactly on the sore spot.
simpler.ur: Cyriax Deep Transverse Friction mein symptomatic tendon, ligament ya muscle ke tissue par us ke fibres ki direction ke aar-paar localized pressure aur movement di jati hai.

text.en: Like rubbing across the grain of a rope rather than along it. Moving across the fibres reaches the sore spot directly and disturbs the tissue more than gliding along it.
text.ur: Jaise rassi ko us ke reshon ke saath nahi balkay aar-paar ragarna. Fibres ke aar-paar movement dard wali jagah tak seedha pohanchti hai aur tissue ko saath saath phisalne se zyada asar karti hai.

text.en:
Three ideas carry this whole technique:
**1.** Location is everything: find the exact tender spot first, then treat that spot only.
**2.** Position the tendon so it is stretched slightly or exposed, so the fingers move the tissue underneath rather than sliding over skin.
**3.** The first minute is uncomfortable, then the area often becomes numbed, which allows deeper work.
text.ur: Is technique ke bare mein pehle scar mobility aur local tissue behavior par asar ka tasawwur diya gaya. Bohat si tendinopathies mein modern evidence yeh sabit nahi karta ke yeh progressive loading se behtar hai. Isay selected cases mein adjunct samjha ja sakta hai, akelay tissue-healing treatment ke taur par nahi.

question.en: Vocabulary first — clinicians use this word a lot. What does **Transverse** mean?
question.ur: Pehle vocabulary — clinicians yeh lafz bohat use karte hain. **Transverse** ka matlab kya hai?

text.en: A painful, overloaded tendon, not always inflamed.
text.ur: A painful, overloaded tendon, not always inflamed.

feedback.en: Close, but that's the meaning of **Tendinopathy**. Read the word **Transverse** once more and try again.
feedback.ur: Qareeb hain, lekin yeh **Tendinopathy** ka matlab hai. **Transverse** ko dobara parhein aur phir koshish karein.

text.en:
So when does **Cyriax Deep Transverse Friction** make sense?
• A well-located tendon or ligament problem with a clear tender spot, for example tennis elbow.
• Sub-acute or persistent problems where the tissue can tolerate pressure.
• As an adjunct before or alongside exercise.
text.ur: Kuch selected localized tendon ya ligament pain; loading-based rehabilitation ke sath adjunct.

text.en:
And just as important — when you should NOT use it, or should stop:
• Open wounds, infection, skin problems or bruising.
• Calcified or unstable tissue, or any suspected partial or full tear that needs medical review.
• Pain that increases sharply or does not settle after the session.
text.ur:
Zyada irritability, anticoagulant dawa ka istemal, nazuk skin, aur acute inflammatory presentation.
Khula zakhm, infection, aisa acute tear jahan loading mana ho, hematoma ya bleeding disorder.
Zyada pressure ko zyada effective samajhna, bruising ya symptom flare ko ignore karna, aur contraindications check na karna ghalat hai. Skin condition, acute injury, bleeding risk aur patient tolerance ko consider karein; concerning response par stop karein.

title.en: How to do it — 6 steps, each with its reason
title.ur: Kaise karein — 6 qadam, har ek ki wajah ke saath

steps.title: Locate the lesion
steps.detail: Use palpation and resisted movements to find the exact tender site.

steps.title: Position the tendon
steps.detail: Place the patient so the tendon is accessible, for example elbow bent for the wrist extensor tendon at the outer elbow.

steps.title: Choose a contact
steps.detail: Use your index finger reinforced by the middle finger, or thumb, with the finger pad fixed on the skin.

steps.title: Move across the fibres
steps.detail: Your whole arm moves the contact finger back and forth across the tendon, keeping the skin and your finger together.

steps.title: Ask about pain and wait for analgesia
steps.detail: Tolerable discomfort is expected. Increase depth once it eases.

steps.title: Retest and follow with movement
steps.detail: Gently stretch or move the tendon and retest the original painful action.

beats.ur:
1. Clinical assessment se symptomatic structure ki tasdeeq karein.
2. Tissue ko aisi position mein rakhein ke sahi jagah contact ho sake.
3. Skin par sirf phisalne ke bajaye target tissue ke aar-paar chhoti transverse movement dein.
4. Dard aur irritability monitor karte rahein.
5. Tolerance ke mutabiq munasib active loading follow karein.

question.en: Imagine the patient is in front of you. What do you do FIRST?
question.ur: Farz karein patient aap ke saamne hai. Aap SAB SE PEHLE kya karenge?

text.en: How much? Typical teaching range: about 5-10 minutes per session, a few sessions per week, always followed by exercise and load management. Reassess after 3-4 sessions.
text.ur: Chhoti aur bardasht ke qabil bouts istemal karein. Bohat irritable tissue par lambi ya aggressive friction se bachein. Aksar chronic tendinopathy mein progressive exercise loading rehabilitation ki bunyadi strategy rehti hai.

beats.patient: Hamza, 44, plumber, outer elbow pain when turning wrenches.
beats.assessment: Resisted wrist extension reproduces pain, with a single tender spot at the tendon's attachment.
beats.treatment: You apply transverse friction for six minutes, with brief pauses and the elbow supported.
beats.reassess: Resisted extension is less painful. He then begins graded strengthening, adjusts his grip and returns in a week.
beats.ur:
Ek misal se poora clinical flow dekhein:
Farz karein assessment mein tendon ke ek maqami hissay par tenderness milti hai. Clinician pehle irritability aur contraindications check karta hai, phir agar munasib ho to brief gentle trial aur us ke baad relevant movement ya loading dobara assess karta hai. Yeh sirf samjhane ki misal hai.

text.en:
The mistakes I see most often:
• Rubbing along the fibres rather than across them.
• Sliding over the skin instead of moving the tissue beneath.
• Skipping exercise afterward.
text.ur:
Sab se aam ghaltiyan:
• Rubbing along the fibres rather than across them.
• Sliding over the skin instead of moving the tissue beneath.
• Skipping exercise afterward.

text.en: Research does not show convincing benefit of friction massage over other treatments for tendon problems. It can reduce pain for some patients in the short term, and should be combined with exercise.
text.ur: Treatment ke baad pain, loading tolerance aur relevant function reassess karein. Is technique ke proposed effects aur clinical benefit har diagnosis mein equally established nahi; evidence aur uncertainty ko honestly communicate karein.

text.en: One line to carry into the clinic: **Find the exact spot, rub across the fibres, then load the tendon.**
text.ur: Friction ko graded tendon loading ka badal na banayein.
